propositions: Code review lacks a concurrency rubric to detect data races from inconsistent synchronization discipline on shared resources

Built-in concurrency overlay uses a two-tier lexical trigger: high-precision committed tier (explicit sync primitives: Lock, flock, RwLock) and project-extensible noisy tier via criteria_routing.json for project-specific tokens
Committed high-precision tier intentionally does not fire on unlocked-twin races (git rm+commit, getmtime+os.remove) which are caught by project-tier vocabulary

Concurrency overlay is advisory (block_threshold 0.95, blocking_enabled false) and surfaces findings for modal races in the corpus (git-index writes, lockfile reclaims, verify-sign drift, CI CAS backoff)
Project extensibility mechanism allows overlays to merge built-in triggers with project-specific tokens and applies_to globs without code changes
